## Detailed Instructions for Documenting Excessive Industrial Emissions in an Air-Quality Report

Here's a detailed breakdown of each step, with explanations and examples to ensure accuracy and clarity in your air-quality report.  This assumes you are responsible for creating the report *after* emissions data has been collected (e.g., by monitoring equipment or stack tests).

**1. Start with the Monitoring Records (Data Collection Review)**

*   **Obtain all relevant data:**  This includes continuous emissions monitoring system (CEMS) data, periodic manual stack test data, opacity readings, continuous opacity monitoring (COM) data, and any other available monitoring data.  Note the date, time, and method of data collection.
*   **Data Quality Control (QC):**  Critically review the data.
